tasks.source: NOAA ISD + IGRA2 2020-2024 weather; synthetic facilities; EPA AERMOD 26135 / BPIPPRM 04274. V2 uses ARM2 for every NO2 case and discrete height menus; v1 scenarios have been public since 2026-10-16. Flat terrain, one control ladder per source, one stack price per facility; five archetypes across 15 weather stations in the full task collection (five eval stations).
tasks.selection: Station-stratified structural shortlist of 30 eligible tasks per split (6 per eval station, 3 per train station), ordered by descending source count, near-binding draft standards (total/limit >= 0.8), uncontrolled-at-GEP upper-bound exceedance, then task ID. Probe draft, cheapest_first_greedy, v1_coordinate_descent, 60-second search, and random_30 with seeds 0..7 using ARM2 fast fields. Failed policies contribute zero savings. Hardness = 1 - greedy_saved/best_saved (zero if best_saved is zero); best includes every probe. Variance proxy is population standard deviation of the eight random saved fractions. Rank hard candidates by the product of within-split midrank percentiles of hardness and variance (then hardness, variance, ID). Reserve two easiest candidates from distinct stations first; fill eight hard slots subject to 2 tasks per eval station / 1 per train station. No model outcomes or pilot membership enter selection.

harness.notes: Claude: Anthropic Messages API with our tool loop, adaptive summarized thinking returned unchanged, several tool calls per response allowed, a one-line start message. GPT: Codex CLI (codex exec) on a ChatGPT subscription, base instructions replaced by our prompt, only the PermitForge MCP tools, the prompt repeated as the first user message, one tool call per response, text.verbosity=low. Provider-default temperature.

grading.reference: Reward is the feasible saved fraction of the draft (all-maximum-control at GEP) design's annualized cost. Invalid, infeasible or no submission scores zero. No proven optimum and no model/search ceiling; 1.0 would require zero cost and is unreachable. Best observed feasible model design per task is reported beside the reward in final-eval.md; it never sets reward.
grading.reward: (cost(draft) - cost(submission)) / cost(draft), feasible submissions only, independently verified with native BPIP/AERMOD. Equal task weight after averaging repeats; 95% station-clustered percentile bootstrap (5 stations, 2000 draws, seed 0). Baselines below use fast-field selection probes, not native submission verification (verification_source: fast-field selection probe); random means average all eight seeds, including infeasible seeds as zero. Best of eight has eight times the random evaluation budget.
